source_text: Population-level reductions in urinary tract infections (UTIs) and balanitis provide public health benefits from male circumcision, as meta-analyses indicate circumcised males experience a lifetime UTI risk of 1 in 12 compared to 1 in 3 for uncircumcised males, with neonatal circumcision conferring a 10-fold protective effect against infant UTIs. [44]
